purpose: Publishes locally generated original and variant image files into an S3-compatible object store without requiring AWS-specific infrastructure in local/UAT.
rules: Publishing is disabled unless shresta.assets.object-upload-enabled is true.
Local/UAT uses MinIO with path-style S3 URLs; production can use AWS S3 or another S3-compatible object store through environment variables.
Every uploaded object uses long-lived immutable cache control because versioned object keys and media URL query parameters provide cache busting.
